targets.expr:
sum by (workload, workload_kind) ((label_replace(
  label_replace((sum by (namespace,pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", image!="", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(deploy_name, deploy_kind) (
  label_replace(kube_pod_owner{namespace="$namespace", owner_kind="ReplicaSet", cluster="$cluster"}, "rs_name", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)")
  * on (namespace, rs_name) group_left(deploy_name, deploy_kind)
  label_replace(
    label_replace(
      label_replace(kube_replicaset_owner{namespace="$namespace", owner_kind=~"$type", cluster="$cluster"}, "rs_name", "$1", "replicaset", "(.*)"),
      "deploy_name", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"
    ),
    "deploy_kind", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.*)"
  )
), "workload", "$1", "deploy_name", "(.*)"),
  "workload_kind", "$1", "deploy_kind", "(.*)"
)) OR (label_replace(
  label_replace((sum by (namespace,pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!="", image!="", namespace="$namespace", cluster="$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (namespace,pod) group_left(owner_name, owner_kind) kube_pod_owner{namespace="$namespace", owner_kind!="ReplicaSet", owner_kind=~"$type", cluster="$cluster"}, "workload", "$1", "owner_name", "(.*)"),
  "workload_kind", "$1", "owner_kind", "(.*)"
)))
